title: Research: exact local and pooled partial width-seven slot optima (no new kappa)
body:
The PR1023 partial width-seven placements were constructive, with optimality left open. This package proves the exact optimum for every k=0..74 converted helpers per call in its mixed-width slot relaxation, uniformly for real 0<a<=1/100. It supplies both the replica-local optimum and the larger pooled32 relaxation, with their scopes kept separate.

The key reduction moves width-seven roles into empty capacity-seven slots by subadditivity, without increasing the inherited positive-child surcharge. The remaining nine width-eight slack moves admit a five-residue Bellman certificate: 45 comparisons, nine exact identities and 30 distinct strictly positive analytic differences. Exact rational Taylor bounds prove every inequality on the entire interval; all 150 local/pooled placements attain the bound within the finite capacities.

This improves 45 of 74 positive replica-local scenarios. Pooling improves 60 of 74 over repeating the local optimum. For example, PR1023's hypothetical k37 optimistic bit endpoint is 0.001789627464386639; the corrected local price is 0.001789671631346367 and the pooled relaxation price is 0.001789725802593009. Complete exact profiles, inherited bad-residue surcharge and adjacent 1e-24 grid rejections are retained.

**Scope:** research relaxation, not a physical width-seven helper, chronological owner map, hosted pooled assignment, changed compiler, practical speedup or new kappa. Prices inherit PR1023's one-unit reduction of one distinct local child per converted helper and assume no additional adapter work. Those assumptions are not implemented here. The selected frontier and upstream remain unchanged.

Reproduce with standard-library Python 3.12:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-partial-width7-optimum
```

Completed checks:

- Registered Python 3.12 replay; uniform certificate; all 150 placements; both retained independent moment engines for priced baseline/new/predecessor profiles.
- Separate original-bin mixed-width DP: 60 complete small cases, 3636 transitions, no production policy/reduction/Bellman import.
- Six mathematical controls, endpoint rejection controls, three on-disk source/evidence/missing-file controls, isolated optimized relocation.
- Metadata/source pins, selected-record integrity and staged whitespace.

Base dadfea6e8a78ff6ba901705f87532a71c6f5bbb8, OS-random seed 3, bit-supplier track; claim/discussion #1269. Full overlap refresh at 21:37 UTC covered 868 open PR bodies and 30 discussions. Coordinator read the written argument and found no scope blocker; that is not independent full verification. Hosted CI and human mathematical review are unclaimed.

Credit Sagar Thakrar / PR1023 for the slot model, partial construction and price brackets; DreamingOfClouds / PR589 and eumemic / PR555 for the bit supplier; DaysSky and the template/hosting lineage; and the retained moment-engine authors. Related PR1128/1179/1253/1256 study physical boundaries or kernel entrances and are not imported or counted as savings. Prepared for Philipp / mightyOil with substantial OpenAI Codex GPT-6 Astra assistance. Apache-2.0. Open next questions cover physical admission and the k>=75 regime.
